comparison.objective: Fit a long blanking panel into the exact U6 rack holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-part alignment and simultaneous clip insertion at two distant endpoints.
comparison.success_condition: Both ends fully engage U6 and remain released for one second; one end or continued holding is partial, and wrong holes score zero.
comparison.reason: Shares precision insertion and release verification, but tests wide two-point panel registration rather than mandrel stabilization, hammer fracture, and recovery of four fragments.
